Purpose

These terms of use govern access to and use of the LexGabon website and related services.

Acceptance

Use of the site implies unreserved acceptance of these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

User account

Some features may require an account. You agree to provide accurate information and to keep your credentials confidential. Activity carried out from your account is deemed to be yours.

Use of the service

You agree to use the site fairly, in compliance with applicable laws and without infringing third-party rights. The following are prohibited in particular: unauthorised access to systems, attempts to overload or alter the service, abusive automated use (unauthorised scraping, etc.).

Ama'IA service

The Ama'IA assistant relies on AI models. Responses may contain errors and do not constitute legal advice. You must verify any information against official sources and, where appropriate, consult a qualified professional.

Intellectual property and content

Editorial and software content remains the property of the publisher or its partners, subject to users’ rights over their own data.

Personal data

Processing is carried out in accordance with applicable law. [To be completed: legal basis, retention periods, recipients, how to exercise rights].

Landing.heroSub: LexGabon centralises legal texts of the Gabonese Republic as well as OHADA and CEMAC texts applicable to Gabon — for legal professionals in French-speaking Africa.
Landing.statsCuratedCaption: Latest dated item cited — authoritative text is the act as published by the issuing body (Gazette, OHADA, CEMAC, BEAC).
Landing.legalNote: Legal texts are published in French — the official language of Gabon.

Chatbot.title: Ama'IA
Chatbot.welcome: Hello. I am Ama'IA, a legal assistant for Gabonese law. Ask your question: I provide a useful summary and, when the index allows, the related text excerpts and links directly under each answer so you can verify and go deeper (official gazette or authentic text prevails).
Chatbot.subtitle: Gabonese law · Legal professionals · Indexed excerpts under each reply
Chatbot.disclaimerExact: Ama'IA is an AI and may make mistakes. Please verify responses.
Chatbot.disclaimerLegal: Its answers do not constitute professional legal advice.
Chatbot.thinkingTitle: Ama'IA is working on your reply
Chatbot.minLengthHint: Enter at least 3 characters to send a question.
Chatbot.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Chatbot.errorTimeout: Timed out (5 min). The backend took too long to respond — retry or check that it is reachable.
Chatbot.errorNetwork: Network error. Check your connection and that the FastAPI backend is running.
Chatbot.errorRateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
Chatbot.sourcesBlockIntro: Passages returned by the server for this answer: use them to check the letter of the law (LexGabon records, search, then official gazette or authentic source).
Chatbot.sourcesEmptyHint: No indexed excerpt for this question: the summary above is not grounded in a LexGabon index passage — continue with search or official texts for precise wording.
Chatbot.noAnswer: No answer was returned by the server.
Chatbot.qualityPrudence: Caution: some elements are not fully supported by citations or a complete disclaimer. Verify sensitive points with a qualified professional.
Chatbot.textareaHint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line.
